title: Is solar energy only for the rich?
summary: Learn about the current options and possibilities for going solar

blocks.text: Learn about the current options and possibilities for going solar

Solar financing options in the Philippines have come a long way this year. Following the Middle East oil crisis and the ensuing solar boom, different government financial institutions and commercial banks have announced the rollout of loans tailored to rooftop solar panel installations.

But there is still much that can be done to make going solar truly affordable for ordinary Filipinos — both in terms of its price and processes. For experts, the country needs to be more creative in how it incorporates solar into community projects.
Watch this video to learn about the current options, constraints, and possibilities for going solar. – Rappler.com
